notes.title: Version 1.11.2
notes.notes:
[h1]Changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Lowered relic costs for 'Bird Coins', 'Offline Rewards', and 'Starting Floor'
[*] Gem sorting will now check if it's sorted before changing sort type
[*] When visiting a floor, you now get offline rewards from that floor
[*] Improved miners movement speed display
[*] Improved miners mining speed display
[/list]
[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Completion percentage no longer requires upgrades to be fully completed
[*] You're no longer able to grade a destroyed gem
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.11.1
notes.notes:
[h1]Changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Updated the create and destroy costs for Abyssal Gems
[*] Reduced the cost of the Starting Floor Relic
[*] Relics now count towards game completion
[/list]
[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed Japanese currency display
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.11.0
notes.notes:
[h1]New Features:[/h1]
[list]
[*] [spoiler]Added the abyssal hand, with 5 slots for abyssal gems[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]Added 7 abyssal gems[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]Added abyssal gem grading[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]Added 3 abyssal upgrades[/spoiler]
[*] Added a new relic
[/list]
[h1]Changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Forge timer is now monospaced (won't jump around anymore)
[*] Reduced costs on most relics
[*] Increased base chance for a special shot in the abyss ([strike]5% [/strike]>> 10%)
[*] Increased max level of special shot upgrade ([strike]25[/strike] >> 30)
[*] Increased Appa's chance to double Ruin Essence ([strike]14%[/strike] >> 15%)
[*] Added a new bundle for the abyss if you don't own bonus shards
[*] Updated Leon's skin cost ([strike]500 Gems[/strike] >> 2500 Singularities of Ignition)
[*] Added currency parsing for 10 more countries
[/list]
[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Abyss now displays damage dealt by the shots
[*] Abyss now displays critical damage dealt
[*] Fixed a bug which caused quests to reroll when claiming the first one
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.10.1
notes.notes:
[h1]Changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Increased Orion's chance to double Refinement Essence ([strike]10%[/strike] >> 12%)
[*] Increased Appa's chance to double Ruin Essence ([strike]12%[/strike] >> 14%)
[*] Increased Nomed's chance to double Ignition Essence ([strike]12%[/strike] >> 14%)
[/list]
[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue which would cause the coal world tutorial to keep appearing
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the coal world tutorial to block the screen on the Chinese version
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the coal world tutorial to display incorrectly on the Japanese version
[*] Disabled automatic cloud restore ([i]Again...[/i])
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.10.0
notes.notes:
[h1]New Features:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added 1 new Essence ([spoiler]Essence of Time[/spoiler])
[*] Added 1 new Singularity ([spoiler]Singularity of Time[/spoiler])
[*] Special forges can now forge regular gems
[*] Regular birds now give you a small amount of Coal when tapped (2~3, works with multipliers)
[*] Weekly quests can now give you Singularities as a reward
[*] Floor travels now have a preview of the distributions
[/list]
[h1]Changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added 1 more special forge
[*] Reduced max speed of special forges ([strike]600%[/strike] >> 400%)
[*] Updated miner completion display
[*] Added 8 new skins
[*] Added 16 new transmutations
[*] Added 5 new stats
[*] Added 1 new tutorial (Coal Pits unlocked)
[*] Updated 1 tutorial (Floor 1000 cleared)
[*] Updated daily rewards (Replaced Gold)
[*] Added an extra travel floor 250 floors after the last one on every mine
[*] Reverted the cost of the Time Warps (100% increase from current costs)
[*] Increased the cost of Platinum Ore to match other recipes ([strike]8[/strike] >> 10 raw platinum)
[*] Increased the cost of Uranium Ore to match other recipes ([strike]16[/strike] >> 20 raw uranium)
[*] Updated Mythic gem base speed ([strike]90s[/strike] >> 80s)
[*] Updated Legendary gem base speed ([strike]210s[/strike] >> 220s)
[*] Reduced Anne's chance to find Gold bars ([strike]5%[/strike] >> 4%)
[*] Reduced Grandelf's chance to find Mythic gems ([strike]1%[/strike] >> 0.8%)
[*] Updated the Delete Game Data text to look more dangerous
[*] Mobile version settings no longer show up on the Steam version
[*] Report issue now opens a Google Forms (Due to Steam Deck incompatibility)
[/list]
[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue which would cause resets to keep you on the same world you reset in
[*] Fixed text scaling issue on transmutations
[*] Might have fixed an issue which would cause the progress bar to not sync
[*] Disabled automatic cloud restore ([i]You win this time bug![/i])
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.9.2
notes.notes:
[h1]Changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Increased the speed growth per level of all forges ([strike]0.03[/strike] >> 0.06)
[*] Reduced the amount of levels to max a forge ([strike]100[/strike] >> 50) 
[*] Reduced the total costs to max forges (about 50% cheaper)
[*] Reduced the costs of most Singularity of Ruin's transmutations
[*] Reduced the costs of all regular raw gem forge recipes (about 50% cheaper)
[*] Reduced the costs of most coal and raw ore forge recipes
[/list]
[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with Ratner's chance to triple raw gems
[*] Fixed an issue with Cooper's chance to triple raw ores
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.9.1
notes.notes:
[h1]New Features:[/h1]
[list]
[*] New passive for Grandelf (1% chance to find Mythic Gems when mining)
[*] New tier display when you reach max tier with a miner, and unlock all skins
[/list]
[h1]Changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Forges now play a SFX when being enabled
[*] Increased Ratner's chance to triple raw gems ([strike]6%[/strike] >> 12%)
[*] Increased Cooper's chance to triple raw ores ([strike]6%[/strike] >> 12%)
[/list]
[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue which would cause the popups to break ([i]again[/i])
[*] Fixed an issue which would cause the first offline forges claim to fail, leading to a temporarily broken forge
[*] Fixed an issue which would cause forges to not update if being enabled for the first time
[*] Fixed issues with localizations in German
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.9.0
notes.notes:
[h1]New Features:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Remade the forges
[*] Forges now have infinite storage
[*] Forges now have dynamic recipe selection
[*] Added Rich Presence
[*] Added an option to reset your save file
[/list]
[h1]Changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Replaced Bonus 25% Forge Speed purchase with Bonus 25% chance to double Coal
[*] Removed multiple upgrades that were not compatible with the new forges
[*] Updated forges UI
[*] Updated forge augment costs ([i]Gems to max all forges unchanged[/i])
[*] Updated most forge's recipes base speed
[*] Updated most forge's recipes resource cost
[*] Updated most alchemy recipes costs and outputs
[*] Updated transmutation amounts ([strike]1 and max[/strike] >> 1, 10 and 100)
[*] Updated calculations for time warps
[*] Moved AFK mode to Mine Settings
[*] [spoiler] Generator Speed upgrades are now additive [/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler] Generator Speed delay reduction increased ([strike]0.2%[/strike] >> 1%)[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler] Generator Output is now calculated through (Power * Speed)[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler] Generator Speed and Power upgrades are now separated[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler] Generator Entries now display how many resources you have[/spoiler]
[*] Added a default sort order for inventory items
[*] Account deletions are now automated
[*] Improved [spoiler] Abyss Tier description[/spoiler] clarity
[*] Clarified that relics require 'The Caves' floor 500 to unlock
[*] Improved forges item display amounts
[*] Saves are slightly smarter in case of data corruption
[/list]
[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] [spoiler] Fixed an issue which could cause the generator to delay the progress display[/spoiler]
[*] Fixed an issue which would cause cloud save checks to happen on every login
[*] Fixed an issue that caused landscape mode UI to have a 16 pixel gap in the middle
[*] Fixed an issue which would cause birds to fly into hard to tap places
[*] Fixed an issue which would cause popups to break on very rare occasions
[*] Fixed multiple issues with the Japanese, Korean and Chinese localizations
[*] Fixed an issue which could double logins and break popups
[*] Possible fix for a false positive invalid email when the password is too big (over 32 chars)
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.8.1
notes.notes:
[h2]Changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [spoiler] Abyss: Special Tower shots now double shards mined. [/spoiler]
[*] Morgan now has a chance to find Coal on any block he breaks (10% + 2% every tier)
[*] Updated Midas and Rick's special description to use icons instead of text
[*] Reduced [spoiler]Offline Rewards Relic Bonus ([strike]400%[/strike] >> 200%)[/spoiler]
[*] Reduced Anne's chance to find Gold Bars ([strike]6%[/strike] >> 5%)
[*] Increased Cooper's chance to triple ores ([strike]5%[/strike] >> 6%)
[*] Increased Ratner's chance to triple gems ([strike]5%[/strike] >> 6%)
[*] Added 2 new skins (Bat Nomed & Winter Adoy)
[*] Added more unique fancy birds
[*] Miners texture size optimized (could reduce game size)
[/list]
[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with purchases price display
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the leaderboards to not open correctly
[*] Fixed multiple issues with the Japanese, Korean and Chinese localizations
[*] Fixed an issue which could cause [spoiler] the Abyss Generator to generate negative souls [/spoiler]
[/list]
